identity.paletteIntent: Paper and ink only: bone white, aged newsprint cream, iron gray, and black. One stamped oxide red is reserved exclusively for an order being issued or a person being killed. No navy and no electric blue.
identity.typographyIntent: Heavy condensed period wood-type headlines; a sober legal serif for body text; monospace for telegraph wire, court language, source text, and casualty records; large unornamented numerals.
identity.shapeLanguage: Rules and columns, hairline dividers, square boxed stamps, ledger cells, docket blocks, and press-bed alignment. Nothing rounded and nothing visually floating.
motionGrammar: clamp shut when an order lands
force accumulates by stacking rather than growing
interactionSignature: date scrubber over a rail network
identity.densityRhythm: Long quiet narrative stretches interrupted by hard columns of figures. Data is allowed to become the argument without decorative treatment.
identity.archivalBehavior: Use untouched credited period photographs when reliable visual evidence survives. When no photograph survives, use a clearly authored historical reconstruction and say so in provenance. Court, diary, newspaper, telegraph, and worker language is visibly marked as source text.
identity.endingLanguage: No summary and no reflection prompt. The narrative ends on the Labor Day date/signature recurrence; terms and note repair follow as appendix-like reference boards rather than a new conclusion.

assetToInterfaceTranslation.paletteSource: Bone paper, aged newsprint, iron-gray printing surfaces, black ink, and the single oxide-red stamp specified by the content master.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.edgeTreatment: Use ruled paper boundaries, press rules, crop marks, docket boxes, carbon ghosting, and hard square edges instead of cards or floating panels.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.controlLanguage: Controls should resemble reading instruments from a record room: date rails, ledger advances, table headings, file tabs, stamped toggles, document chains, and fixed comparison fields.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.spacingLanguage: Compose type into each scene's named safe zone. Alternate broad blank paper/sky fields with compressed records and columns so the page breathes like a file being opened and read.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.transitionLanguage: Spread sections propagate along rails, telegraph lines, or repeated entries; clamp sections resolve with a completed rule, stamp, signature, or locked column. Do not add generic fades, parallax, or ornamental easing.
